name: Holden Jolley
headline: AZURE SOLUTION ARCHITECT | CLOUD INFRASTRUCTURE & SECURITY
contact: Hickory, NC · Open to Bay Area relocation
summary: Azure-focused cloud and security professional with 5+ years translating business, security, and operational requirements into resilient, cost-conscious solutions. Led modernization initiatives supporting ~16,000 users, 3,000 endpoints, and ~100 Azure VMs, balancing resiliency, security, operational simplicity, and total cost. Delivered automation that reduced device provisioning from 2.5-3 hours to 15-20 minutes, built executive alignment for least-privilege security changes, and developed Azure reference architectures validated through Bicep, secretless GitHub OIDC, and live Azure Resource Manager What-If.

projects.title: Azure E-Commerce Reference Architecture
projects.description: Designed a distributed Azure commerce platform to protect internet-facing traffic, decouple transactional workloads, support regional recovery, and allow application and data components to scale independently. Implemented with Front Door + WAF, App Service, Cosmos DB, Service Bus, private networking, managed identity/RBAC, and observability; dev/test/prod Bicep validation is green and the dev architecture passes live ARM What-If through GitHub OIDC.

projects.title: Privacy-Preserving AI Age Assurance Platform
projects.focus: Privacy risk reduction & secure AI integration
projects.description: Designed a privacy-first age assurance landing zone that minimizes exposure and retention of verification images while returning only a binary approval decision. Uses client-side AES-256-GCM + RSA-OAEP envelope encryption, private Container Apps inference, Key Vault Premium/HSM-backed keys, Managed Redis anti-replay state, and Private Link; foundation/workload Bicep validates cleanly and the dev foundation passes live ARM What-If through GitHub OIDC.

projects.title: Cost-Optimized Azure Static Portfolio
projects.description: Designed portfolio hosting to meet availability, HTTPS, custom-domain, CI/CD, and recovery requirements at a target of $0/month Azure hosting within Free quotas. Uses Azure Static Web Apps Free, security headers, GitHub Actions/OIDC, and source-control recovery; live ARM What-If resolves the intended footprint to one resource group and one Free-tier Static Web App, with production deployment deliberately manually gated.

experience.role: Endpoint And IS Security Specialist / Cloud Infrastructure & Security Lead
bullets: Architected and led migration of a ~100-VM RDS environment to Azure across four teams, covering infrastructure, networking, NSGs, VPN connectivity, monitoring, remediation, and cost strategy; selected site-to-site VPN over ExpressRoute based on workload resiliency requirements and total cost, and implemented reserved/pre-purchased compute capacity to reduce ongoing infrastructure spend.
Automated VM health monitoring, reboot remediation, and failure escalation to improve service resilience, accelerate recovery from common failures, and reduce manual operational effort.
Led modernization of 1,500+ endpoints from MDT/on-prem AD to Entra ID, Intune, and Autopilot, standardizing provisioning and moving the device lifecycle toward cloud-based management.
Designed Autopilot profiles, naming standards, Conditional Access, certificate authentication, and application deployment patterns to create a repeatable, policy-driven endpoint architecture.

Built Freshservice -> Entra -> Intune provisioning automation that reduced device deployment time from 2.5-3 hours to 15-20 minutes - roughly a 90% reduction - accelerating onboarding while reducing technician effort.

Designed and automated identity lifecycle management for employee onboarding and inactive-account cleanup, replacing recurring manual administration and saving several staff-hours per day. Retained manager-approval checkpoints before stale Active Directory accounts were removed, preserving business ownership while reducing orphaned-access risk.

Built executive alignment with the CIO to remove standing local administrator rights by translating endpoint privilege risk and developer-productivity concerns into a business case that addressed anticipated resistance from Software Development leadership. Implemented an EPM/JIT least-privilege model to preserve developer workflows while reducing standing administrative access.
Implemented Microsoft Global Secure Access to modernize secure connectivity to enterprise resources and reduce reliance on traditional network access paths.
Led UiPath automation and onboarding/offboarding process redesign to standardize workflows and reduce manual service-desk effort.
Administered Freshservice workflows, automations, service requests, and integrations supporting repeatable service delivery and process automation.
Built MDT -> Password Manager Pro automation for unique device administrator credentials, reducing manual credential handling and improving consistency.
Supported transition of device credential management to Intune as part of the broader Autopilot modernization.
